title: Before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the race arrives. With her own debut approaching, Daiwa Scarlet watches from the stands next to Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The atmosphere at this year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup feels different, and both feel as if something amazing is about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, immediately before the race, Sweep Tosho trades determined boasts with Kawakami Princess and the others.
